verdict.rationale: Brex documents first-party REST APIs authenticated with dashboard-generated tokens, so its operations can be scripted without the UI. It also offers registrable webhooks and an HTTP MCP endpoint for agent-driven, non-interactive use. However, there is no CLI and no CI-specific guidance, and tokens must first be created manually in the dashboard. Missing for 10: official CLI or headless runner, documented CI/CD usage patterns, non-interactive service-account credential provisioning, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: To start making calls to Brex APIs, generate a user token from your Brex dashboard and pass it along in your API call headers.
Register an endpoint to start receiving selected webhook events
claude mcp add --transport http brex https://api.brex.com/mcp
The payments API allows you to initiate and manage payments and vendors from your Brex business accounts.
